title: Naga: Vedic Encoding for Deep State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.13510v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents Naga, a deep State Space Model (SSM) encoding approach inspired by structural concepts from Vedic mathematics. The proposed method introduces a bidirectional representation for time series by jointly processing forward and time-reversed input sequences. These representations are then combined through an element-wise (Hadamard) interaction, resulting in a Vedic-inspired encoding that enhances the model's ability to capture temporal dependencies across distant time steps. We evaluate Naga on multiple long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) benchmarks, including ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, ETTm2, Weather, Traffic, and ILI. The experimental results show that Naga outperforms 28 current state of the art models and demonstrates improved efficiency compared to existing deep SSM-based approaches. translated_title: Naga：面向深度状态空间模型的吠陀编码方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了Naga，一种受吠陀数学结构概念启发的深度状态空间模型（SSM）编码方法。所提出的方法通过联合处理正向输入序列和时间反转的输入序列，为时间序列引入双向表示。随后，这些表示通过逐元素（Hadamard）交互进行组合，形成一种吠陀启发的编码，增强了模型捕捉跨远距离时间步的时间依赖关系的能力。我们在多个长期时间序列预测（LTSF）基准上评估了Naga，包括ETTh1、ETTh2、ETTm1、ETTm2、Weather、Traffic和ILI。实验结果表明，Naga超越了28个当前最先进的模型，并且与现有的基于深度SSM的方法相比展现出更高的效率。研究结果表明，引入结构化的吠陀启发式分解可以提供可解释性和计算（效率方面的）优势。
tldr: Naga提出了一种受吠陀数学启发的深度状态空间模型双向编码方法，通过逐元素交互融合正向与时间反转序列，在多个长期时间序列预测基准上超越28个最先进模型并显著提升效率。
en_tdlr: Naga proposes a Vedic-inspired bidirectional encoding for deep state space models that fuses forward and time-reversed sequences via element-wise (Hadamard) interaction, outperforming 28 state-of-the-art models on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks with improved efficiency.
